conclusion: V5 BK=32 BD=64 matches V3 (±2%). D=128 B*H>=16: V5 wins by 2-8%. D=64 large N: V3 wins by 1-5%. No clear promotion case.
key_findings: BK=32 optimal (fewer K-tiles than BK=16, lower TGP than BK=64/128)
BD_tile=64 optimal (fewer D-chunks=fewer barriers, 1 chunk for D=64, 2 for D=128)
Non-power-of-2 BK crashes GPU (BlockLoaderT integer truncation)
WM=2 halves occupancy benefit, WM=8 doubles TGP. WM=4 optimal.
TGP=4,096B (8 TGs/CU) vs V3 TGP=14,336B (2 TGs/CU): occupancy wins
But V5 needs 6 barriers/K-tile (D=64) or 11/K-tile (D=128) vs V3's 2/K-tile
recommendation: V5 stays experimental (MFA_ENABLE_V5=1). V3 remains production default.
